lines.speaker: Thu (Office Administrator)
lines.text: Good morning, this is Thu from An Phat Company. I had a missed call from Mr. Duc.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Receptionist)
lines.text: Good morning. Let me put you on hold and check if he's available.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Receptionist)
lines.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Duc is visiting a customer. I can't transfer the call right now.

lines.speaker: Thu (Office Administrator)
lines.text: No problem. I'm calling on behalf of our director about the new office chairs.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Receptionist)
lines.text: Sorry, it's a bad line. Did you say office chairs?

lines.speaker: Thu (Office Administrator)
lines.text: Yes, office chairs. We ordered fifty, but only thirty arrived yesterday.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Receptionist)
lines.text: I see. May I have your name again? Could you spell that?

lines.speaker: Thu (Office Administrator)
lines.text: It's Thu, T-H-U. Please ask him to call my direct line, 0903 456 789.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Receptionist)
lines.text: Got it. He'll be back after lunch, so he should call you this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Thu (Office Administrator)
lines.text: Thank you. If I don't hear from him, I'll leave a voicemail on his mobile.

questions.q: Why can't Khoa transfer the call to Mr. Duc?
options: He is in a long meeting

questions.q: What is the problem with the order?
options: The chairs are the wrong color
Only thirty of fifty chairs arrived

questions.q: When should Mr. Duc call Thu back?
